integrity: Proof and standalone exact rational tests are supplied. The finite checks do not certify the infinite theorem; the published-source comparison does not claim exhaustive novelty, and no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Integer expanding interval maps and fixed positive window only; mean rather than orbitwise statistics or a fluctuation theorem. The base and radius are fixed as sample size grows. Earlier equivalent Euclidean formulas may exist outside indexed literature.
title: Log-periodic finite-size excess in expanding-interval pair correlations
